items.title: Delfeayo Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: That’s they way that they can fit in. It’s like, if you’re five, six years old, you can start beating on something. Elvin was the youngest. Tootie Heath is the youngest. Max [Roach], [Art] Blakey – I’m pretty sure they’re the youngest. So that’s how Jason came along. But for me it was hanging out with my brothers, doing the recording. Wynton would charge me to make his audition tapes sound like Maurice André records.
